Definition: Player chooses one reward, item, shard, core, pet, tech part or equipment option.
Optimizer_Treatment: Evaluate every eligible option before opening.

Definition: Long-lived currency spent in shops or systems.
Optimizer_Treatment: Track balance and every possible spend.

Definition: Temporary or recurring event currency.
Optimizer_Treatment: Optimize exchange shop before expiry.

Definition: Currency spent in the Clan Shop.
Optimizer_Treatment: Compare stock, limits and progression bottlenecks.

Definition: Currency or entry item tied to a game mode.
Optimizer_Treatment: Value against mode rewards or saved Gems.

Definition: Consumes one key to open its linked chest.
Optimizer_Treatment: Use expected-value tables and event chest-opening milestones.

Definition: Used to level, awaken, reset or unlock Survivors.
Optimizer_Treatment: Score by owner/global DPS gain.

Definition: Used in Astral Forge, Cosmic Cast, Chaos Fusion or Xeno Transmute.
Optimizer_Treatment: Compare DPS gain per Relic/Faction/Transmute Core.

Definition: Used for tech resonance, Twinborn and related upgrades.
Optimizer_Treatment: Compare multiplier, fusion and Overload alternatives.

Definition: Used for pet levels and awakening.
Optimizer_Treatment: Separate pet DPS, owner buffs and affection ATK.

Definition: Used to summon, awaken or reforge Xeno Pets.
Optimizer_Treatment: Compare owner buff and resonance gains.

Definition: Used to star, reset or obtain collectibles.
Optimizer_Treatment: Link to exact global or system-specific bonus.

Definition: Choose a gear item at the displayed rarity.
Optimizer_Treatment: Value each gear option using current forge and inventory needs.

Definition: Awards random equipment.
Optimizer_Treatment: Use expected value rather than selector value.

Definition: Choose one tech part.
Optimizer_Treatment: Preserve Twinborn pairs and resonance dependencies.

Definition: Choose a normal pet.
Optimizer_Treatment: Value awakening, owner buffs, affection and Xeno unlock dependency.

Definition: Choose a Xeno Pet.
Optimizer_Treatment: Value owner bonus, resonance skills and existing copies.

Definition: Choose a collectible from an eligible pool.
Optimizer_Treatment: Value exact star breakpoint and linked gear/tech effect.

Definition: Direct-use item that resets, revives, rerolls or skips content.
Optimizer_Treatment: Value the refunded resources or Gems/time saved.

Definition: Opens into a random reward.
Optimizer_Treatment: Use probability-weighted expected value.

Definition: Temporary resource used inside one event.
Optimizer_Treatment: Spend before expiry and compare milestone conversion.

Definition: Owned cosmetic or visual item.
Optimizer_Treatment: Exclude unless a verified stat bonus exists.

Definition: Character record rather than a consumable.
Optimizer_Treatment: Handled by the Survivor dataset.

Definition: Owned collectible record rather than a container.
Optimizer_Treatment: Handled by collectible and set datasets.
